title: Steep Beach
content: I have a reoccurring dream of many people being gathered on a big beach with a steep, sandy shoreline. Everyone hanging out on towels, swimming, kids playing. Almost always some point, the sky becomes much darker (it's usually dark beforehand), waves become huge and dangerous, and everyone only seems to notice at the last possible moment. There has been a few instances where I've managed to save a couple people by dragging them out from under sand before the waves crash down again. I also feel like before the waves come, I'm going around warning people about what's going to happen, but no one seems to listen or care. What is this? Has anyone else experienced dreams like this? They're always so real, I can vividly recall the texture of sand under my feet and in my hands. I have this dream or something similar about 2 times a month.
